Game Overview

Count Pusher is a action title where lead your group of multiplying humanoids through perilous paths in Count Pusher's vibrant world. Strategically gather numbers to conquer formidable foes and outwit tricky traps, while tackling mathematical challenges along the way. Master fast-paced decision-making and build your unstoppable army to defeat bosses in this thrilling auto-run adventure.
